column1: # The shared palette corpus: each file in this folder and the verdict the player gives it, one
# line per problem, in order. Cinder (player/cinder-ui/src/palette.rs) and Flint
# (crates/flint-core/src/palette.rs) both hold their copy to this file word for word.

column2: `two words` cannot be a palette name: use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (at most 32)
`cinder` is the built-in palette — rename the file
an accent of its own needs all six accent keys — missing day.accent_ink, day.row_select, night.accent, night.row_select
line 4: `day.bg` wants a colour like #1a2b3c, got `#12345`
day.ink on day.bg: contrast 1.05, needs at least 4.50
day.dim on day.bg: contrast 1.05, needs at least 3.00
day.ink on day.panel: contrast 1.01, needs at least 4.50
day.dim stands out as much as day.ink (1.05 vs 1.05) — dim is for secondary text
day.faint stands out as much as day.dim (2.86 vs 1.05)
